Download ExcelDownload PDF **46** Checkpoints **8** Sections As needed Site Engineer [IS 456:2000](https://infralens.in/code/IS-456-2000) [IS 10262:2009](https://infralens.in/code/IS-10262-2009) [IS 1786:2008](https://infralens.in/code/IS-1786-2008) [IS 516:1959](https://infralens.in/code/IS-516-Part-2-1959) [IS 1199:1959](https://infralens.in/code/IS-1199-Part-2-2018) Related [📐IS 456](https://infralens.in/code/IS-456) [✏️Minimum Ceiling Height Resi…](https://infralens.in/thumbrules/minimum-ceiling-height-residential) [📘Column Load Capacity Tables](https://infralens.in/handbook/column-capacity) [📖Min cover for RCC](https://infralens.in/knowledge/minimum-cover-rcc-is-456) [🔧rcc-design](https://infralens.in/tools/rcc-design) ### Checklist Preview Expand all ↓ | S.No. | Checkpoint | IS Requirement | Status | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | A. A. SCOPE OF WORK | | A1 | Description of RCC Work
Acceptance: Clear narrative covering nature of work, extent, and project phase | Detailed description of concrete work scope | | | A2 | Location / Structural Elements Covered
Acceptance: List with reference to drawing numbers; include all elements in this work package | Identification of elements (slabs, beams, columns, footings, etc.) and zones | | | A3 | Estimated Volume (m³)
Acceptance: Calculated from drawings; used for material planning and sampling frequency | Total volume of concrete planned for this work | | | A4 | Duration / Schedule
Acceptance: From project schedule; phased if required | Planned start and completion dates | | | B. B. REFERENCE DOCUMENTS | | B1 | Applicable IS Codes
Acceptance: IS 456:2000, IS 10262:2009, IS 383:1970 (Coarse and Fine Aggregate), IS 1786:2008, IS 516:1959, IS 1199:1959, IS 1498:1970 (Steel), IS 4031:1988 (Cement Testing) | List of all relevant Indian Standards for concrete work | | | B2 | Approved Drawings List
Acceptance: List drawing nos. and latest approved revisions | Reference drawing numbers with revisions | | | B3 | Approved Mix Design
Acceptance: Document ID, grade, w/c ratio, slump, cement type, approval date and approver signature | Reference to approved IS 10262 mix design document | | | B4 | Project Specification
Acceptance: Grade, exposure class, durability requirements, special requirements (if any) | Concrete specification from project contract/design doc | | | C. C. MATERIALS | | C1 | Cement - Type and Grade
Acceptance: Grade 43/53; source and Mill Test Certificate (MTC) records maintained | Type of cement (OPC/PPC/PSC) and grade per IS 269/455/1489 | | | C2 | Cement Storage Requirements
Acceptance: In covered store; max 10 bags high; on raised platform; FIFO rotation; shelf life 3 months max from date of packing; stock rotation recorded | Storage conditions per IS 456 Cl. 5.2 | | | C3 | Fine Aggregate (Sand) - Source and Grading
Acceptance: Grading Zone II or III; natural or manufactured sand; silt content ≤3% (for fine sand) or ≤5% (coarse sand); testing per IS 2386:1963 Part I | Source and compliance with IS 383:1970 grading zone | | | C4 | Coarse Aggregate (Stone/Gravel) - Source and Grading
Acceptance: 20mm nominal size typical; flakiness index ≤30%; elongation index ≤30%; testing per IS 2386:1963 Part I; all sizes tested before batching commenced | Source and compliance with IS 383:1970 grading | | | C5 | Aggregate Testing Frequency
Acceptance: Sieve analysis every 500 tonnes; silt/moisture every 100 tonnes; flakiness/elongation every 1000 tonnes; records maintained with dates | Schedule for regular testing of aggregates | | | C6 | Reinforcement Steel - Grade and Type
Acceptance: Grade Fe 500D (primary); diameter per drawings; Mill Certificates (MC) obtained; traceability maintained | Steel grade per IS 1786:2008 (High strength deformed bars) | | | C7 | Steel Storage and Protection
Acceptance: On raised platform (min 300mm height); covered from rain; inspect for rust/damage before use; oiled if stored >6 months; bending at site tested per IS 1608:1995 (bend/rebend test) | Storage conditions for reinforcement steel | | | C8 | Water Quality
Acceptance: Potable water; pH 6-8; salt content <500 mg/litre; chloride <200 mg/litre; sulphate <200 mg/litre; testing done before use | Water used in concrete mix per IS 456 Cl. 5.4 | | | C9 | Admixtures - Type and Dosage
Acceptance: Type (plasticizer/retarder/accelerator/air-entraining); dosage in mL/100kg cement or % by mass; approved mix design reference; batch testing if new source | Chemical admixtures per IS 9103:1999 and approved mix design | | Showing 17 of 46 checkpoints ·View all → A. SCOPE OF WORK A1Description of RCC Work Detailed description of concrete work scope (IS 456:2000) ✓ Clear narrative covering nature of work, extent, and project phase A2Location / Structural Elements Covered Identification of elements (slabs, beams, columns, footings, etc.) and zones (IS 456:2000) ✓ List with reference to drawing numbers; include all elements in this work package A3Estimated Volume (m³) Total volume of concrete planned for this work (IS 456:2000) ✓ Calculated from drawings; used for material planning and sampling frequency A4Duration / Schedule Planned start and completion dates (IS 456:2000) ✓ From project schedule; phased if required B. B. REFERENCE DOCUMENTS B1Applicable IS Codes List of all relevant Indian Standards for concrete work (Multiple) ✓ IS 456:2000, IS 10262:2009, IS 383:1970 (Coarse and Fine Aggregate), IS 1786:2008, IS 516:1959, IS 1199:1959, IS 1498:1970 (Steel), IS 4031:1988 (Cement Testing) B2Approved Drawings List Reference drawing numbers with revisions (IS 456:2000) ✓ List drawing nos. and latest approved revisions B3Approved Mix Design Reference to approved IS 10262 mix design document (IS 10262:2009) ✓ Document ID, grade, w/c ratio, slump, cement type, approval date and approver signature B4Project Specification Concrete specification from project contract/design doc (IS 456:2000) ✓ Grade, exposure class, durability requirements, special requirements (if any) C. C. MATERIALS C1Cement - Type and Grade Type of cement (OPC/PPC/PSC) and grade per IS 269/455/1489 (IS 269:2015 (OPC), IS 455:1989 (PPC), IS 1489:1991 (PSC)) ✓ Grade 43/53; source and Mill Test Certificate (MTC) records maintained C2Cement Storage Requirements Storage conditions per IS 456 Cl. 5.2 (IS 456:2000 Cl. 5.2) ✓ In covered store; max 10 bags high; on raised platform; FIFO rotation; shelf life 3 months max from date of packing; stock rotation recorded C3Fine Aggregate (Sand) - Source and Grading Source and compliance with IS 383:1970 grading zone (IS 383:1970, IS 1199:1959 Cl. 3) ✓ Grading Zone II or III; natural or manufactured sand; silt content ≤3% (for fine sand) or ≤5% (coarse sand); testing per IS 2386:1963 Part I C4Coarse Aggregate (Stone/Gravel) - Source and Grading Source and compliance with IS 383:1970 grading (IS 383:1970, IS 1199:1959 Cl. 3) ✓ 20mm nominal size typical; flakiness index ≤30%; elongation index ≤30%; testing per IS 2386:1963 Part I; all sizes tested before batching commenced C5Aggregate Testing Frequency Schedule for regular testing of aggregates (IS 383:1970, IS 1199:1959) ✓ Sieve analysis every 500 tonnes; silt/moisture every 100 tonnes; flakiness/elongation every 1000 tonnes; records maintained with dates C6Reinforcement Steel - Grade and Type Steel grade per IS 1786:2008 (High strength deformed bars) (IS 1786:2008, IS 1498:1970) ✓ Grade Fe 500D (primary); diameter per drawings; Mill Certificates (MC) obtained; traceability maintained C7Steel Storage and Protection Storage conditions for reinforcement steel (IS 456:2000 Cl. 5.6) ✓ On raised platform (min 300mm height); covered from rain; inspect for rust/damage before use; oiled if stored >6 months; bending at site tested per IS 1608:1995 (bend/rebend test) C8Water Quality Water used in concrete mix per IS 456 Cl. 5.4 (IS 456:2000 Cl. 5.4, IS 1199:1959) ✓ Potable water; pH 6-8; salt content <500 mg/litre; chloride <200 mg/litre; sulphate <200 mg/litre; testing done before use C9Admixtures - Type and Dosage Chemical admixtures per IS 9103:1999 and approved mix design (IS 9103:1999) ✓ Type (plasticizer/retarder/accelerator/air-entraining); dosage in mL/100kg cement or % by mass; approved mix design reference; batch testing if new source Showing 17 of 46 ·View all → Inspection Sign-Off APPROVED APPROVED WITH CONDITIONS REJECTED -
